status: actual local route table with explicit separate cohorts; branch validation/CI not claimed

provenance.build: same successful build with all six public keys and 2,259 files d09 build; no rebuild for follow-up
provenance.network: mobile 150 ms/1.6 Mbps/CPU4;desktop 20 ms/10 Mbps/CPU1; simulated via CDP
provenance.proxy: owned exact-loopback only; overhead included; no production application call
provenance.api: local invented corpus with 120 ms replay; no --fixture override

semantics.inp: one local scripted press, not field INP
semantics.cache: cold/repeat differs in cache and consent; not a pure cache-effect experiment
semantics.theme: all matched original desktop controls were Dark mode, inferring light before both navigations; per-navigation init resets same app key. No dark-repeat evidence. Daily uses local radio, not theme. This is not a DOM-attribute proof.
semantics.consentBanner: legacy boolean is DOM presence, not visible shown state. Actual Daily diagnosis found display:none while DOM flag true; cold LCP may name earlier banner paint.
semantics.resourcePaths: ResourceTiming paths omit origin; blocked Sentry /api/... is not app API ownership proof. Original origin-qualified sentApi counters remain authoritative.
semantics.uiEvidence: recorded heading/buttons/LCP metadata, not a new screenshot of the full page or complete board-row text

initial.scope: original artifact unchanged; its zero exit did not attest complete interaction evidence

environment.clsDefinition: largest session window (shifts under 1 s apart, window under 5 s) without recent input, read before the lab press; clsSum is the plain sum the cls field held before 18 November 2026; clsInputFlagged sums the shifts flagged hadRecentInput before the press
environment.tbtDefinition: long tasks observed under the CPU throttle, each clipped to fcp..measuredAt, less 50 ms, summed (Lighthouse sums the same way over a simulated trace)
environment.summaryDefinition: one row per profile, path and cache state: the median of each metric over the measured samples (the lower middle one for an even count, so each value is one a sample measured), the LCP element of the median-LCP sample, errors = samples a failure left without a measurement
environment.requestsDefinition: requests the page made per kind at the lab interception; sent = responses the origin returned over the network, without cache hits or answers the lab fulfilled
environment.serverWaitDefinition: responseStart - requestStart (navigation.ttfb before 18 November 2026; resources[].ttfb still uses it)
environment.scope: anonymous,essential consent,read-only; cold browser is NOT proven cold server; inpMs is one scripted press per load, NOT field INP

dailyFollowup.scope: separate Daily-only cohort; no full96rerun; original Daily12paint rows retained
